css: h1, .home-title, .game-title, .modal-title { text-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.55); } .nav-btn.active { box-shadow: 0 6px 18px rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.5); } .game-card { border-color: rgba(167, 123, 255, 0.16); } .action-btn { background: linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.34), rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.1)); } .chart-bar-fill, .history-bar, .event-bar i, .ach-meta-bar-fill { background: linear-gradient(90deg, #7c3aed, #c084fc) !important; } ::selection { background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.5); } ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: rgba(139, 92, 246, 0.45); } body::before { background: radial-gradient(circle at 20% 25%, rgba(124, 58, 237, 0.4), transparent 50%), radial-gradient(circle at 80% 78%, rgba(192, 132, 252, 0.26), transparent 50%) !important; }
